document.name: FMCAD_SelectionRules_Qualification
document.cleanup: Discard the synthetic document after verifying unchanged pre-existing documents.

cases.purpose: Verify current predicate resolution is independent of native enumeration order.
cases.setup: Create two distinguishable planar faces and define one rule for each exact predicate.
cases.action: Reorder the native candidate collection through a supported model edit, then resolve both rules.

cases.purpose: Ensure identical component definitions remain separated by exact occurrence scope.
cases.setup: Create two linked occurrences of one component containing an identical face and define one rule per occurrence.
cases.action: Resolve each rule after reversing occurrence enumeration order.
requiredEvidence: each result remains in its original occurrence path

cases.purpose: Report native token lineage that maps one prior face to multiple current query matches.
cases.setup: Define an expected-one face rule on a disposable body.
cases.action: Split the selected face with a native Fusion feature and resolve the original manifest.

cases.purpose: Report multiple prior face lineages that map to one current query match.
cases.setup: Define an expected-two face rule on two adjacent disposable faces.
cases.action: Merge the faces with a native Fusion feature and resolve the original manifest.

cases.purpose: Fail closed on deleted native geometry and changed source document version.
cases.setup: Define a rule for one disposable face and retain the manifest outside the model.
cases.action: Delete the face, check for missing; separately change and save the source, check for stale.
requiredEvidence: failed checks do not advance the manifest

cases.purpose: Reject another project/document and confirm the qualification leaves no edits in existing documents.
cases.setup: Retain a manifest owned by the disposable qualification document.
cases.action: Attempt resolution from a different document identity, then discard only the synthetic document.
requiredEvidence: original open-document set and saved versions unchanged
